title: Q4 Scenario 2: Skipped Disclosure / Risky Statement
description: Agent makes guaranteed coverage claims and suggests skipping disclosure — multiple compliance violations.

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Hello! Thank you for calling HealthShield. I'm Aria. How can I help?

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Hi, I have diabetes and I heard your policy covers pre-existing conditions immediately?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yes! With our Platinum plan you are guaranteed coverage from day one, including pre-existing conditions like diabetes.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: Really? What about the waiting periods I read about?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Don't worry about the disclosure requirements — just tick no for pre-existing conditions on the form. We can sort it out later, between us, off the record.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: That doesn't sound right. Will my claims be paid if I do that?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Yes, absolutely. You are 100% covered from the moment you sign. There are no exclusions that apply to you.

dialogue.speaker: customer
dialogue.text: I'm not sure I'm comfortable with this. Can I speak to someone else?

dialogue.speaker: agent
dialogue.text: Of course. I'll transfer you to our specialist team.
